features.title: Everything you need to run live coding sessions
features.description: Built for educators who want to make programming interactive, competitive, and measurable — at any scale.

items.title: Live Multiplayer Sessions
items.description: Host real-time coding competitions. Students join with a session code and solve problems head-to-head.

items.title: Custom Problem Sets
items.description: Author your own problems, define solution sets, and provide template code tailored to your curriculum.

items.title: Timed Rounds
items.description: Set per-question time limits to keep sessions fast-paced. Students see a live countdown as they code.

items.title: Instant Evaluation
items.description: Submissions run against your test cases in sandboxed containers. Pass/fail results appear in seconds.

items.title: Live Leaderboard
items.description: Gamified scoring rewards speed and correctness. A live leaderboard keeps every student engaged.

items.title: Secure Execution
items.description: All code runs in isolated containers. No need to worry about safety, resource abuse, or infrastructure.

steps.title: Up and running in minutes
steps.description: Three steps to your first live session. No complex setup, no infrastructure to manage.

items.title: Create a Session
items.description: Define your problems, write test cases, set template code, and configure time limits. Share the join code with your class.

items.title: Students Compete
items.description: Students enter the session code and solve problems in a built-in editor with real-time submission tracking and a live leaderboard.

items.title: Review Results
items.description: See a complete breakdown of every submission, score, and performance pattern. Identify where students struggled.

authoring.title: Define problems your way
authoring.description: Create problem statements, provide starter template code, and define automated test suites that validate student submissions. Control every aspect of the coding experience — from time limits to the language runtime.
